Definition: a Chivvite, one of the aboriginal tribes of Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Chivviy is a Hivite, one of the peoples of Canaan, and the name runs from the promise to the conquest. God promises Moses a land of Hivites, the law lists them among the nations to be driven out, and the kings of the Hivites gather with the rest to fight Joshua.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Hivites show that God's promise always had an enemy to face, and the conquest was a real war against real peoples. I hold that the God who promised the land also gave the victory for it.
